description: This file defines a React component GetMarkdownPlugin that uses Lexical editor context to extract markdown content from the editor state. It exposes a getMarkdown method via a ref, which converts the editor's state into markdown string using a transformer.

classes.name: GetMarkdownPlugin
classes.description: A React component providing markdown extraction functionality from a Lexical editor instance, exposing getMarkdown through ref.

methods.name: getMarkdown
methods.description: Retrieves the current editor state and converts it to a markdown string.
